contentList.content: Vex
When you damage a target with a Handaxe, Rapier, Shortsword, Shortbow, or Hand Crossbow, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next attack against it.
Vexed
The creature that applied Vex has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on its next attack against this target.
Sap

When you <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">hit</LSTag> with a Mace, Spear, Flail, Longsword, Morningstar, or War Pick, the target gains <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on its next attack.
Sapped
Has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on its next attack roll.
Slow
When you damage a target with a Club, Javelin, Light Crossbow, or Longbow, reduce its <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> by 3 m.
Slowed
Movement speed is reduced by 3 m.
Topple

When you <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">hit</LSTag> with a Quarterstaff, Battleaxe, Maul, or Trident, the target must succeed a <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or fall <LSTag Tooltip="Prone">Prone</LSTag>.
Push
When you <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">hit</LSTag> with a Greatclub, Pike, Warhammer, or Heavy Crossbow, you can push the target 3 m away.
Graze
When you <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">miss</LSTag> with a Glaive or Greatsword, deal damage equal to your attack <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Ability Modifier</LSTag>.
Cleave
Once per turn, <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">hitting</LSTag> with a Greataxe or Halberd lets you make another attack against a nearby target.
Cleave Attack
Attack another creature near the target of your triggering attack. On a hit, deal the weapon's damage without adding a positive ability modifier.
Nick

Once per turn, attacking with a Light melee weapon while wielding a Dagger, Light Hammer, Sickle, or Scimitar in your off hand lets you make your next off-hand attack without spending a Bonus Action.

Dual Wielder still allows an additional off-hand attack using a Bonus Action.
Weapon Mastery
Choose mastery properties to use with eligible weapons.
